name: Turnaround
summary: A business in distress. Stabilise first (cash, liquidity, stop the bleeding), diagnose root causes (usually a mix of revenue, cost and management), then execute a recovery plan with quick wins and structural fixes.
opening_line: In a turnaround I'd first secure short-term survival (cash runway and quick wins), then diagnose the root causes across revenue, costs and operations, and finally build the longer-term recovery plan.
when_not_to_use: Healthy business with a mild margin dip: use profitability

buckets.name: Stabilise
questions: How many months of cash are left?

buckets.name: Diagnose
questions: Which units or products lose money, and why?

industry_adaptations.note: Loss-making hospital departments: payer mix, volume, and fixed-cost absorption.

common_mistakes: No sequencing between quick wins and structural change
